name: AI Training Data Broker
description: Searches and reads guidance on selling or licensing company data to AI labs, sourcing licensed training data and de-identification. Read-only MCP over a public blog; no sign-up.

skills.name: Latest Articles
skills.description: Lists the newest articles, optionally only for sellers, buyers or de-identification, with a one-line summary and link each.

skills.name: Search Articles
skills.description: Searches the blog by topic, such as exclusive license or de-identification, and returns matching articles with summaries and links.

skills.name: Read Article Opening
skills.description: Returns one article by slug or URL: title, audience, the opening 120 words and the questions its FAQ answers, with a link to the rest.

skills.name: Connector Search And Fetch
skills.description: Connector-style search that returns ids, then fetch of one article by id, for clients that expect those two tools.
